guide.title: Turn on Developer options
guide.detail: On the phone, open Settings, then About phone, and tap Build number seven times.

guide.title: Turn on USB debugging
guide.detail: Open Settings, then System, then Developer options, and turn on USB debugging.

guide.title: Connect the phone
guide.detail: Connect it to this computer with a USB cable. When the phone asks, tick "Always allow from this computer" and tap Allow.

guide.title: Or connect over Wi-Fi
guide.detail: In Developer options, turn on Wireless debugging and tap Pair device with pairing code. On this computer, run "adb pair <ip:port> <code>", then "adb connect <ip:port>".

guide.title: Open Chrome on the phone
guide.detail: Browsentic drives the Chrome app, so it has to be open.

guide.title: Switch on Android
guide.detail: In your browser, open the Browsentic side panel and switch on Android.

report.summary: Ready. Switch on Android in the Browsentic side panel to drive it.
